About

Ledgerwood

A two-chair lash and brow studio for people who want the work to be invisible. No packages, no upsells, no music you have to talk over.

Ledgerwood is two chairs on the second floor of a Wickenden Street walk-up. Tova has been mapping lash lines for fourteen years and still does every set herself. Appointments run long on purpose — a full set takes two hours and the last twenty minutes are for checking the work in daylight.

Aftercare

Look after the work and it lasts.

After your visit

Keep the set dry for the first twenty-four hours: no steam, no swimming, no hot yoga. After that, wash them daily with a lash-safe foaming cleanser and a soft brush — clean lashes hold retention far longer than dry ones. Sleep on your back or side if you can, skip oil-based removers entirely, and never pick at a lash that feels loose. Come back every two to three weeks.

Staying on schedule

Regular visits do more for the result than any product does. If you are not sure when to come back, ask Tova at the end of your appointment — the interval depends on you, not on a chart.

If something is not right

Tell us. Small adjustments are free and quick, and we would much rather hear about it in the first few days than not at all.

Frequently asked

Questions people actually ask.

How long does a full set take?

Two hours for a classic set, closer to two and a half for volume. We book the room for the full window so nobody is rushed.

Will extensions damage my natural lashes?

Not when they are mapped and weighted correctly. Damage comes from extensions that are too long or too heavy for the natural lash carrying them, which is why we map every set to your own lash line rather than to a picture.

How often do I need a fill?

Every two to three weeks for most people. Past four weeks a fill becomes a new set, and we price it as one.

Can I wear mascara?

On a classic set, a lash-safe water-based mascara on the tips only. On volume, no — it collapses the fans and takes the set with it when you remove it.

I have sensitive eyes. Is there an option?

Yes. We keep a low-fume adhesive for reactive clients. Tell us when you book so we can patch test at least forty-eight hours ahead.

What if I do not like them?

Say so in the chair. Adjusting curl or length while you are still here costs nothing. Removal within seven days is free.

Do you do brows as well?

Lamination, tint, and shaping. Brows are a separate appointment — we do not stack them behind a full set.
